# Dr. Smile Dental Group

> A Smile is Happiness You'll Find Right Under Your Nose

Dr. Smile Dental Group (https://www.doctorsmile.com) is the official landing page
for a family-owned, multi-specialty dental practice serving Southern California.
This page is a chooser/landing hub that routes visitors to the two practice
websites and lists the practice's office locations and phone numbers.

## Key facts

- Brand: Dr. Smile Dental Group
- Tagline: "A Smile is Happiness You'll Find Right Under Your Nose"
- Practice type: Multi-specialty dentistry (oral surgery, dental implants,
  cosmetic dentistry, Invisalign/orthodontics, All-on-Four prosthetics)

## Practice websites

- Hossein Javid, DDS: http://www.drsmiledental.com/
- Mariam Nadi, DDS & Kayvon Javid, DDS: https://doctorsmileonline.com/

## Content

The page contains: practice logo, tagline, two doctor/practice chooser panels,
and an "Our Locations" section (5 office cards — each with a one-line service
blurb, address/directions link, phone number(s), shared hours, and a
"More Info" link to that office's dedicated page).
